# onebusaway

> Python SDK for the OnebusawaySDK API, version 0.0.1. Install with `pip install onebusaway` and import `onebusaway`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/OneBusAway/python-sdk/blob/main/README.md): installation, usage, async client, retries, timeouts
- [api.md](https://github.com/OneBusAway/python-sdk/blob/main/api.md): every resource, method and type
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/OneBusAway/python-sdk/blob/main/src/onebusaway/_agent/SKILL.md): agent skill with tested examples
